## Physical dynamics

{{< include ../_includes/dynamics-applications.qmd >}}

### Water-energy systems {#water-energy-dynamics}

My engineering interests focus on water-energy systems and the sustainable operation of multi-energy systems serving data centers.

### Materials processing {#precision-materials-manufacturing}

I work with [Professor Fengqi You](https://www.peese.org/professor/) on neural operators for dynamic modeling and optimization in precision materials manufacturing.
